question: Should CodexBar expose the learned “Available full sessions” estimate as a common Codex, Claude, and Antigravity product contract with this draft’s conservative fail-closed semantics?
rationale: The code establishes a new cross-provider user-facing metric, while the related design PR remains open. Tests can validate mechanics but cannot decide whether the shared metric is the intended permanent product surface.

options.title: Sponsor the shared contract
options.body: Approve the descriptor-based estimate after the design settles its semantics, then require completion and redacted live proof before merging.

options.title: Limit the initial rollout
options.body: Approve a narrower provider subset or internal-only data path until each provider’s quota semantics are validated.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the existing quota and pace presentation without adding a learned session-equivalence headline for now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the shared contract
recommendation.body: Approve the descriptor-based estimate after the design settles its semantics, then require completion and redacted live proof before merging.
